name: inkfield-bridge
description: Bridge service between Connectome bots and the published InkField web app (https://github.com/ileivoivm/inkField). Does NOT self-host InkField — headless rendering drives the real published instance via its own agent-facing snapshot hooks (see README.md, License posture). Provides a queued/rate-limited/coalescing POST /render used by the paint_inkfield bot tool (GPU worker first, local fallback), plus a drop-page inbox for human-authored recordings.
